conbody.p: Press ? beside the notification bell to open the help panel. It shows the page of this manual for the screen you are on, written for the release your workspace is on, so what it describes matches what you see. Links between pages open in the panel, Back returns, and the search box at the top searches the whole manual. Open in the docs opens the same page on the docs site, where a menu lets you read the manual for other releases.

Help also follows what you are doing on the page. It opens on the part of the manual for the form, field or dialog you are working in, the button you pressed last or the tab you are on, and on the page's own topic where the manual has nothing more specific. For example, the board's + Add card opens Creating a card and a card's drawer The card drawer; the agent editor's write-mode setting opens Write mode: proposal vs direct; New Run on the V&V page opens Test runs; the Members tab of project settings opens Project access (members); and the link panel's add-link form opens Creating links. While the panel is open it moves with you, a moment after you change section or tab. Once you follow a link or search in the panel, it stays on what you chose until you go to another page or open it again. Only which section of the screen you are in is used to choose the page, never anything you have typed.
